meta.name: Vietnam administrative units — old (63 provinces) and new (34 provinces) schemes with ward-level mapping

source.data_provenance: generated by the dataset's authors from the official conversion table under Quyết định 19/2025/QĐ-TTg, NQ-UBTVQH resolutions and 2026 amendments (hand-transcribed by them); NOT yet reconciled against the official file

meta.sort_order: 1-based Vietnamese alphabetical rank of `name` within its parent (provinces: global); digits compare numerically; DB-collation independent

corrections.reason: ward carried a province that disagrees with its own district's province; all other wards of that district carry the owning province
ward carried a province that disagrees with its own district's province; all other wards of that district carry the owning province
duplicate district row created by the ward-province defect above
duplicate district row created by the ward-province defect above

unresolved.reason: a whole-district mapping exists although the district has wards (each ward has its own mapping); not loaded as a district mapping, needs checking against the official table

notes: Old and new codes live in separate namespaces: the same number can denote different units (e.g. 26737 is old ward Đa Kao and new ward Tân Định). Always key by scheme.
district_mappings cover districts that have no wards (islands); not used by the API yet (district conversion deferred).
ward_mappings is many-to-many; 'ambiguous'/'split_population' rows mean part of the old ward moved to this new ward.
